title: Architecture-Indexed Causal Law Replication, Search-Budget Atlas Stability, Law-Family Compression, Engine-Descriptor Morphisms & Minimal Architecture Coordinate Identification

search_budget_axis.selection_rule: No budget may be selected after selective intervention outcomes are opened. P25 tests all frozen budgets; 80000 is the inherited P24 canonical budget.

descriptor_authority.minimality_rule: Enumerate every subset of the frozen candidate coordinates in increasing cardinality. A subset earns descriptive sufficiency only if engines with identical descriptor vectors have identical full K8 law signatures. No post-outcome descriptor invention is allowed.
descriptor_authority.identification_ceiling: With three heterogeneous engines, descriptor sufficiency is descriptive over the frozen engine set, not population-level causal identification of architecture features.

atlas.alignment: within-family-side average-tie empirical copula per engine; engine-symmetric median plus rank spread

prospective_claims.name: fresh_architecture_index_replication
prospective_claims.criterion: At canonical 80000-node atlas, no K8 state is an architecture-free intervention-response bisimulation block and each engine retains a nonconstant law family.

prospective_claims.name: search_budget_atlas_stability
prospective_claims.criterion: Report all frozen budget-pair coordinate drift and partition agreement; no threshold is retrofitted into a pass/fail claim.

prospective_claims.name: law_family_compression
prospective_claims.criterion: Find the smallest frozen descriptor subset whose induced engine partition refines the observed full-law equivalence partition.

prospective_claims.name: minimal_architecture_coordinate
prospective_claims.criterion: A one-coordinate descriptor is admissible only if its value partition alone never merges engines with different full K8 law signatures. Otherwise report the minimal cardinality or IDENTIFICATION_UNDERDETERMINED.

claim_ceiling: P25 may replicate architecture-index necessity without proving that architecture identity is fundamental rather than a proxy for unmeasured mechanism coordinates.
Budget stability of the atlas does not imply stability at untested budgets or time controls.
Descriptor compression over three engines is a finite-set morphism result, not a general causal effect of a source-code feature.
No learned or outcome-optimized representation map may be introduced in P25.
